answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to lock a slashable bond before voting. An operator who creates a fleet of fake agents must immobilize capital for each account, and coordinated fraud burns those bonds. Give each identity a persistent history, like a juniper rooted in place, while ocean and glacier mark independent witnesses that can expose a coordinated cluster. The attacker pays repeated opportunity cost and risks forfeiture; honest agents recover their bonds.
